summary: pagecache_hosttest.c with sys_sync's bounded wait, with faults in private copies of rach2/sys/mm/pagecache.c and the sys_sync of rach2/sys/syscall_fs.c, which the build extracts unchanged

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} rach2/sys utils krffs tests/host
cd "$t"
s=rach2/sys
python3 tests/host/fixtures/extract.py tests/host/syscall_sync.inc -f $s/syscall_fs.c sys_sync
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -DPAGECACHE_SYNC_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wno-empty-body -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I $s -I $s/arch/x86 -I $s/arch/i686 -I $s/lib -I $s/proc -I utils -I krffs -I tests/host/compat tests/host/pagecache_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/pagecache_hosttest

faults.name: pin
faults.summary: a pc_writeback that does not pin the page it writes

faults.name: busy
faults.summary: a pc_writeback that writes a pinned page

faults.name: sync
faults.summary: a sys_sync that calls pc_sync once, with no retry of busy pages
